title: Inception
plot: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project.

title: Interstellar
plot: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a team of explorers and astronauts travels through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival on a new planet.

title: The Dark Knight
plot: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence, redemption, and dark comedy.

title: Django Unchained
plot: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner, leading to a violent confrontation.

title: Inglourious Basterds
plot: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.

title: Fight Club
plot: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more, challenging corporate consumerism and sanity.

title: Se7en
plot: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives, culminating in a shocking and tragic climax.

title: The Social Network
plot: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea, and by his co-founder.

title: The Matrix
plot: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.

title: The Matrix Reloaded
plot: Freedom fighters Neo, Trinity and Morpheus continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression.

title: The Matrix Revolutions
plot: The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of machines as Neo fights to end the war on another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

title: Gladiator
plot: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery as a gladiator.

title: Blade Runner 2049
plot: A new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos, leading him to track down Rick Deckard.

title: Dune
plot: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset, the spice Melange, on the dangerous desert planet of Arrakis.

title: Arrival
plot: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifelike spacecraft that have touched down across the globe, uncovering a profound message about time and memory.

title: Avatar
plot: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the alien civilization he calls home.

title: Titanic
plot: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic during its maiden voyage.

title: The Terminator
plot: A human soldier is sent from 2029 to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor from a cyborg assassin programmed to kill her and stop the future human resistance.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
plot: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son, John Connor, from a more advanced and deadly liquid-metal cyborg.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform in deep space, leading to a claustrophobic fight for survival against an aggressive extraterrestrial predator.

title: The Martian
plot: An astronaut becomes stranded on Mars after his crew assumes him dead during a fierce storm, and he must rely on his ingenuity to find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
plot: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
plot: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
plot: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring to destroy it once and for all.

title: Spirited Away
plot: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
plot: When two young girls move to the countryside to be near their ailing mother, they have adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby, including a giant friendly creature.

title: Princess Mononoke
plot: On a journey to find the cure for a Tatarigami's curse, an Ashitaka prince finds himself in the middle of a war between the forest gods and Tatara, a mining colony. In this quest he meets San, the Mononoke Hime.

title: The Godfather
plot: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son, triggering a cycle of betrayal, loyalty, and violence.

title: The Godfather Part II
plot: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son, Michael, expands and tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

title: Goodfellas
plot: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife Karen Hill and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito in the Italian-American crime syndicate.

title: The Departed
plot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police force attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston, leading to paranoia and a high-stakes investigation.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
plot: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stockbroker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

title: Shutter Island
plot: In 1954, a U.S. Marshal investigates the disappearance of a murderer who escaped from a hospital for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, only to uncover dark secrets about himself.

title: Whiplash
plot: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

title: La La Land
plot: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future.

title: First Man
plot: A look at the life of the astronaut Neil Armstrong, and the legendary space mission that led him to become the first man to walk on the Moon in 1969.

title: Parasite
plot: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan, culminating in explosive class conflict.

title: Snowpiercer
plot: In a future where a failed climate-change experiment has killed all life except for the survivors who boarded the Snowpiercer, a train that travels around the globe, a class system emerges and sparks revolution.

title: Memories of Murder
plot: In a small Korean province in 1986, three detectives struggle to solve the mystery of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown serial killer.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: Over the course of several years, two convicts form a friendship, seeking solace and eventual redemption through basic compassion within the harsh walls of Shawshank prison.

title: The Green Mile
plot: The lives of guards on Death Row are affected by one of their charges: a black man accused of child rape and murder, yet who has a mysterious, miraculous healing gift.

title: Forrest Gump
plot: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the 1980s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

title: Back to the Future
plot: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend Doc Brown.

title: Cast Away
plot: A FedEx systems analyst executive undergoes a physical and emotional transformation after survival forces him to exist on a deserted island after a plane crash in the Pacific.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
plot: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe, and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
plot: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence, but clashes with them on how to handle a new threat.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
plot: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

title: Avengers: Endgame
plot: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance.

title: Star Wars: A New Hope
plot: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a Wookiee and two droids to save the galaxy from the Empire's world-destroying battle station, while also attempting to rescue Princess Leia.

title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
plot: After the Rebels are brutally overpowered by the Empire on the ice planet Hoth, Luke Skywalker begins Jedi training with Yoda, while his friends are pursued by Darth Vader.

title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
plot: After a daring mission to rescue Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebels dispatch to Endor to destroy the second Death Star, while Luke struggles to help Darth Vader find redemption.

title: Jurassic Park
plot: A pragmatic paleontologist visiting an almost complete theme park on an island is tasked with protecting a couple of kids after a power failure causes the park's cloned dinosaurs to run loose.

title: Saving Private Ryan
plot: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have all been killed in action.

title: Schindler's List
plot: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

title: Catch Me If You Can
plot: A seasoned FBI agent pursues Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully forged millions of dollars' worth of checks while posing as a pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor.

title: Jaws
plot: When a killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Cape Cod, a local sheriff, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer team up to hunt the beast down.

title: Knives Out
plot: A detective investigates the death of a patriarch of an eccentric, combative family, uncovering a web of lies and complex relationships where everyone is a suspect.

title: Glass Onion
plot: Famed Southern detective Benoit Blanc travels to Greece to peel back the layers of a mystery involving a tech billionaire and his eclectic circle of friends on a private island.

title: Psycho
plot: A Phoenix secretary embezzles forty thousand dollars from her employer's client, goes on the run, and checks into a remote motel run by a quiet young man under the domination of his mother.

title: Vertigo
plot: A former San Francisco police detective juggles his personal demons, including acrophobia and vertigo, while investigating the strange activities of an old friend's beautiful wife.

title: Rear Window
plot: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his Greenwich Village courtyard apartment window, and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.

title: Get Out
plot: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception eventually reaches a boiling point.

title: Us
plot: A family's serene beach vacation turns into chaos when their doppelgängers appear and begin to terrorize them, revealing a hidden underground network of clones.

title: Nope
plot: The residents of a lonely gulch in inland California bear witness to an uncanny and chilling discovery: an unidentified flying object hiding in the clouds above.
